verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents running Elasticsearch, Kibana, or the Observability solution itself locally or as a dev instance. The closest items are an agent-in-a-container option (collector side, not the platform) and generic 'open by design' / 'open source platform' marketing, which are adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
